ticketsCreated.title: MCP resources: expose board state as readable resources

lines: Now let me look at more tickets and key source files.
Now let me read the web source and a few more key files.
I've read enough to understand the project well. Now I'll create 5 actionable backlog tickets.

Created 5 new backlog tickets:

| ID | Title | Priority | Labels |
|---|---|---|---|
| `M3UCOezD` | Webhook notifications for board events | medium | dream, feature, notifications |
| `OXCjaoLM` | Board search and filter | medium | dream, feature, ui |
| `Sb2OIaQ0` | Run log rotation and auto-pruning | medium | dream, tech-debt, storage |
| `9E8j0wT6` | Guest worker auto-reconnect with backoff | medium | dream, reliability, guest |
| `UquB4p1P` | MCP resources: expose board state as readable resources | medium | dream, feature, mcp |

**Reasoning behind each:**
- **Webhooks** — the "work while you sleep" pitch needs an out-of-band signal when things finish or get stuck; currently there's no external notification path at all
- **Board search** — `.mysteron/runs/` already has 100+ files and tickets accumulate in bin fast; the web UI has no way to find anything
- **Run log pruning** — the runs directory grows unboundedly, a real operational problem on active projects
- **Guest auto-reconnect** — a dropped connection currently requires manual re-join, undermining the distributed fleet use case
- **MCP resources** — the SDK supports them and board state is a natural fit; spec/doc reads on every ticket run would be cheaper and subscribable
